headline: REGN Q2 Deep Dive: Pipeline Progress and Product Momentum Drive Outperformance
summary: Biotech company Regeneron (NASDAQ:REGN) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 16.7% year on year to $4.29 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $14.29 per share was 40.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
